source order; page order

::: abstract

The order between the two front-matter blocks is the author's, because floats
stack in the order they are issued and this look issues them from the body. So
keywords written above an abstract typeset above it, which is what the author
asked for rather than a mistake to name.

:::

# Introduction

Body content above either block is what is refused; one above the other is not.
